title: Only skip draft preparation for the Payables Agent's own e-documents with agent-driven line matching
summary: Draft preparation skip now applies only to the Payables Agent's own e-documents when agent-driven line matching is enabled, restoring normal preparation for other e-document services.
key_points: With the agent-driven line matching experiment on, draft preparation is skipped only for e-documents of the AGENT E-Document service
E-documents from other services, such as PEPPOL XML, again get a vendor, purchase order, line matching and VAT posting group in the draft
The experiment check and the agent service check are now separate conditions
Nothing changes when the experiment is off
AGENT service code duplicated as a label because Payables Agent depends on E-Document Core
